query:
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS (
    FILTER (
        INFO.VIEW.MEASURES ()
        ,[Name] IN { "PL Base", "PL % NR", "PL Compare A", "PL Δ A", "PL Δ A %", "PL Compare B", "PL Δ B", "PL Δ B %", "PL FY Budget", "PL FY LE", "PL Δ LE vs Budget" }
    )
    ,"name", [Name]
    ,"data_type", [DataType]
    ,"folder", [DisplayFolder]
)
ORDER BY [name]
